descriptionChirho: The cardinal numeral 'five' used independently or with prepositions/articles to denote the quantity five.
The numeral 'five' as part of the compound number fifteen, formed with the word for ten.
The numeral 'five' used in ordinal/temporal contexts meaning 'the fifth' (day, month, year).
The numeral 'five' in compound-ordinal contexts meaning 'the fifteenth' (day of the month).
